lines: There are more cats in the dining hall than chairs. I'm simply asking who signed off on that.
Cats keep the vermin down. What do YOU keep down? Not your ale, I hear.
That was one time, it was a celebration, and the cat started it.
The cat has a bedroom. Do you have a bedroom? No. Think about that.
I have a corner of the dormitory and my dignity!
The cat has both of those AND a cushion.
Tonight I'm proud to stand for ale. Plain, honest, barrel-aged ale.
And I stand for more ale. Which, frankly, includes yours.
More ale is just ale with ambition! It has no platform!
Its platform is the second barrel. Voters love the second barrel.
Voters love the first barrel! It's where the second barrel gets its ideas!
Then why is the first barrel always empty? Answer the question.
No.
Now hear me out, they did bring us fruit last {season}.
They brought fruit and a lecture! I didn't order a lecture! They COUNT our trees!
Okay. Fine. I've heard myself out. No.
Every year somebody goes fishing and the carp goes dwarfing. It's a pattern.
Carp are fish. Fish! They live in water and fear the net.
Have you SEEN a carp? It doesn't fear the net. The net fears it.
This is fearmongering. Next you'll tell me the turtles have a plan.
I wasn't going to say it on air, but the turtles absolutely have a plan.
We're done here. The turtles are fine.
A noble wants three steel bins by the end of {month}. That's called governance.
We don't have any steel. That's not governance, that's a wish.
A strong fort makes wishes come true. With hammers if necessary.
The last time a mandate failed, the hammerer did come. With a hammer.
Accountability! You're welcome!
He hammered the blacksmith! The blacksmith didn't even like bins!
The hospital is hoarding socks. Forty socks. Nobody in {fort} has forty feet.
Socks are medical supplies. Have you ever been wrapped in a sock? It heals.
That's not medicine, that's laundry with a bedside manner.
Tell that to the miner whose leg was saved with cloth last {season}.
It was saved with thread! The socks were just watching!
Somebody has to watch. That's the socks' role in society.
Our ancestors didn't dig down so we could stop at a comfortable depth.
Our ancestors dug down and found things with too many eyes.
Every great hall starts with a hole somebody wasn't supposed to make.
And so does every great funeral. Have you met the deep?
I'd love to meet the deep! I'd shake its hand!
It has seven hands and none of them want shaking.

debate.topic: IS THE DEPOT TOO FAR AWAY?
lines: Haulers walk a full day to reach the trade depot. It's practically a pilgrimage.
It's exercise! Our haulers have the finest calves in all of {civ}.
They spend half the trip asleep in the corridor!
Rest is part of a balanced haul. You wouldn't understand, you have a desk.
This desk is ALSO very far from the depot!
Then walk to it and stop complaining on my airtime.
Sometimes a dwarf throws a table because the dwarf needed to throw a table.
It was MY table. I was eating off it.
Then you were eating off a symbol of oppression!
I was eating off a plate of plump helmets!
Feelings first, furniture second. That's my position.
My position was under the table, which is where I ended up.
Magma is a tool. Like a hammer, but warmer and more enthusiastic.
A hammer doesn't flow into the dining hall when somebody pulls the wrong lever.
That's a lever problem. Don't blame the magma for the lever's choices.
The lever is labelled 'DO NOT'. The rest of the label melted.
Then carve a stone label! Problem solved! Next question!
The next question is where the engineer went. And I think we know.

debate.topic: DO WE NEED A BIGGER TAVERN?
lines: We have {pop} citizens and a tavern built for twelve. Dwarves are drinking on the stairs.
Stair drinking builds community. You meet everyone going up and down.
You meet them when they fall on you!
Again: community. Look it up.
{citizen} has been sleeping on the landing since {season}!
And has never been more connected to the community.
With {pop} of us, {fort} is cosy, intimate, efficient.
It's empty. Our entire militia is one dwarf and a determined goat.
That goat has never lost a fight.
That goat has never been IN a fight! It eats the doors!
Deterrence!

debate.topic: ARE WE RUNNING OUT OF BOOZE?
lines: The barrels are low and I want answers. I want them in a mug.
This is panic. The brewers are working around the clock.
The brewers are asleep in the tavern. I walked past them on the way here.
They're resting their brewing arms! It's a strategy!
Then strategise faster! I'm drinking water like an elf!
Take that back. On air. Right now.

debate.topic: IS THERE SUCH A THING AS TOO MUCH ALE?
lines: We've stockpiled so much drink the barrels are stacked in the corridors.
And? Name one problem a corridor full of ale has ever caused.
I tripped on a barrel, then I drank the barrel, then I was late for work.
Sounds like the barrel solved its own problem.
That's not the point!
It's exactly the point. The system works.
Winter is a surface rumour. Down here it's always a pleasant stone temperature.
The pond froze and a fisherdwarf stood on it for an hour like a fool.
That's not winter, that's a personal choice.
He was frozen IN it! We had to send for a pick!
And did the pick feel cold? No. Because winter isn't real.
The food stockpile is down and I've seen crumbs on certain beards.
Are you accusing my beard? On national broadcasting?
I'm accusing a beard. If the beard fits...
A beard doesn't fit, it flows. And this one is innocent.
Then why does it smell like a prepared roast?
Because I'm a dwarf of taste! Literally!

debate.topic: HOW LOUD SHOULD A WAKE BE?
lines: We lost one of our own. A dignified fort grieves with a quiet drink.
A dignified fort grieves with SEVERAL loud drinks and a song.
That song has a chorus about goblins' mothers.
And they'd have wanted that. They hummed it constantly.
...They did hum it constantly.
Then pour another one. For the memorial slab.
Kobolds are small, shy, and interested in our things. Like children. Or cats.
They stole my sock! My GOOD sock!
Did they steal it, or did they rescue it from the hospital?
...I hadn't considered that angle.
Kobold sock liberation. Think about it.
I don't want to think about it. I want my sock back.
We need a mayor who listens. Who sits in the meeting hall and nods.
We had that. He nodded off. We need somebody awake.
Awake is a very low bar.
And the last mayor tripped over it.
At least he didn't ban things! The baron bans something new every week!
The baron banned the export of beds! He was ahead of his time!
Stone chairs built this fort. Stone chairs built our spines.
Stone chairs ruined our spines. My spine is now a stone chair.
Wooden chairs are an elven conspiracy. Ask yourself who profits.
The carpenter profits! Who you just insulted! He's in the studio!
...Lovely chairs, carpenter. Very sturdy.
Too late. He's left. He took a chair.
Another wave of migrants. Where are they sleeping? On my floor, that's where.
Migrants bring skills! We just got our fourth cheesemaker.
We don't have any cheese!
And now we have the potential for SO much cheese.
We don't have milk either! We have one goat and it eats doors!
You leave that goat out of this.
Goblins burn, steal, and lay siege. That's three strikes. They're out.
Have you ever actually sat down with a goblin? Over a drink?
Once. Briefly. Then he took my lantern and set my door on fire with it.
That's one goblin. You can't judge a whole dark tower on one lantern.
I absolutely can. It was a very nice lantern.
Raise the bridge, flood the moat, lock the gate. Nobody gets in.
Including the caravan carrying our ale ingredients?
We'll negotiate with the caravan through the murder holes.
That's not negotiation, that's dropping rocks politely.
Very politely. I'd write 'sorry' on every rock.
Writing on rocks is called engraving. That's a whole other department.
Every wall in this fort has an engraving of a dwarf looking at another engraving.
That's art! It reflects on itself! It's deeply meaningful!
There's one of me in the latrine. Striking a dwarf. I've never struck a dwarf.
The engraver says you were thinking about it.
I'm thinking about it RIGHT NOW!
See? Prophetic. Masterful work.
Children keep climbing into the well. The well is not a playground.
The well is the only fresh water in {fort}. Let it be popular.
A child fell in and came out a novice swimmer!
That's career development! You're against career development!
I'm against children in the drinking water!
Then drink ale like a dwarf and stop worrying.
Our soldiers live in the barracks, ready to fight at a moment's notice.
They're asleep in the barracks, ready to fight at a moment's nap.
That's ready-napping! It's an advanced military technique!
A goblin walked past three of them yesterday. Waved. Took a cat.
Took a cat? Which cat?
Does it matter? We have so many cats.
A dwarf locks herself in a workshop demanding shells, and we just GIVE them to her!
And she makes a legendary artifact! That's the deal! It's tradition!
The artifact is a bracelet with an image of the bracelet on it.
Which is worth more than this entire studio.
Then why is it sitting in a bin next to my socks?
Because the hospital wouldn't take it.
The humans offer cloth and want our crafts. Mugs for cloth. Perfectly fair.
They tried to buy our ALE. Who sells ale? Who even asks?
It was surplus ale!
There's no such thing! Ale doesn't have a 'surplus', it has a 'later'!
Something moves the bins at night. I've heard moaning in the stockpile.
That's the night-shift haulers. They always moan.
One of them walked straight through a wall!
That was a door. He'd just never seen one open before.
Then why is his name on a memorial slab?
...Right. Somebody call the engraver.
Water falling from the sky. Uninvited. Onto our dwarves. I call that an invasion.
It's weather. It happens. Go inside.
I AM inside. I'm inside angrily.
Then you're living the dwarven dream. Stop complaining.
Dogs guard, dogs hunt, dogs stay loyal. Unlike certain pundits.
Cats keep vermin down AND judge you silently. That's a full service.
The cats have adopted half the fort. Nobody asked them.
Nobody asks a cat. That's what makes them leaders.
Let the record show I am pro-dog and anti-tyranny.
Let the record show the dog ate the record.

debate.topic: IS THE TAVERN A SACRED SPACE?
lines: Two dwarves met at the tavern and got married. The tavern is a sacred space now.
The tavern was ALWAYS a sacred space. It has ale.
So we agree?
Never. Next topic.
There are forty levers in the machine room and nobody knows what thirty-nine of them do.
That's what makes the job exciting! Every pull is a surprise!
Last week's surprise flooded the farm.
And the farm has never been so well irrigated. Results!
The crop was plump helmets! Now it's a pond!
A pond with plump helmets in it. That's a feature.
Our children should be playing, learning, wrestling in the barracks like proper toddlers.
Children are tiny haulers with unlimited enthusiasm. Use them.
Last time we let a child haul, he hauled himself onto the drawbridge lever.
And pulled it! Very good grip. Future champion.
The goblins walked right in!
And left very confused. Tactical genius, frankly.
The artifact should be displayed in a public hall for every citizen to admire.
It belongs with the dwarf who made it. She'll know if we move it. She knows.
She's asleep!
She knows in her sleep.
That's not how sleep works!
That's not how SHE works.
A dwarf without a helm is a dwarf asking for a falling rock.
A cap stops nothing. Do you know what stops a falling rock? Not standing under it.
You can't avoid every rock! The ceiling is ALL rock!
Exactly. So why bother with the helm?
Because it's FASHIONABLE.
Ah. Now we get to the truth.
A wandering bard has asked to stay the {season}. I say yes. Culture!
He knows one song. It's about a tree.
It's about a SAD tree. It's very moving.
It's elven propaganda with a lute.
...I'm humming it now.
That's how they get you.
We have more coffins than citizens. Is the carpenter trying to tell us something?
It's called planning ahead. A forgotten beast won't wait for paperwork.
What forgotten beast?
Exactly. It's been forgotten. Which is why we need coffins.

debate.topic: IS PIG TAIL CLOTH REAL FABRIC?
lines: Pig tail cloth is the backbone of dwarven fashion. Soft, rugged, tail-adjacent.
It's woven from a plant. You're wearing a weed.
You're wearing a SHEEP.
I'm wearing a respectable shirt, made with a sheep's full consent.
Nobody asked the sheep! The sheep was never consulted!
Now you care about consent? You're wearing a WEED!
Nobles provide leadership, vision, and a reason to dig more rooms.
The baron's bedroom has three statues of the baron. He IS the decor.
Inspirational! Look at that jawline!
He's requested a fourth room for his other shoes.
Leadership requires shoes.
Leadership requires not throwing a tantrum when the shoes are copper.

debate.topic: DID THE CARAVAN RIP US OFF?
lines: We traded a masterwork crown for three bags of rope reed and a cage. Shrewd.
Shrewd for THEM. The broker cried. Happy tears.
He was moved by our generosity.
He was moved into a second house.
Some dwarves have been going outside. On purpose. To 'look at the sky'.
The sky is free and it's big. What's the harm?
One came back with a strange appreciation for trees.
That's... okay, that is worrying.
He's started naming them.
Seal the doors.
There's goblin blood in the entrance from three sieges ago. Nobody mops.
It's a historical feature. Visitors love it. Very educational.
It's tracking into the dining hall!
Then the dining hall is ALSO educational.

debate.topic: ARE WORK ORDERS OUT OF CONTROL?
lines: The manager approved an order for a hundred bone crossbow bolts.
We have a lot of bones.
WHY do we have a lot of bones?
...Because of the crossbows.
This is a cycle! A bone cycle!
And it's sustainable. Read the report.
Our soldiers are dressed in silver. Silver! Like party ornaments!
When the goblins see them, they'll be dazzled. Dazzled into retreat.
Silver is soft! It bends!
So does a goblin, if you hit it hard enough.
...That's actually fair.
Thank you. I've been working on that one since {season}.

debate.topic: IS IT TIME TO MOVE OUT?
lines: This fort is ancient. The engravings have engravings. Time for a fresh start.
Leave? After all these years? Who would care for the cats?
The cats would care for themselves. They always have.
That's exactly what a cat would say. Show me your paws.
I am NOT a cat!
Prove it. Don't knock anything off this desk.

debate.topic: ARE WE A REAL FORT YET?
lines: We have a wagon, a hole, and a still. That's a fort. Legally, that's a fort.
It's a camping trip with a door.
The door is GRANITE.
The door is leaning against a tree.
Granite doesn't need walls! It has confidence!
We need beds, bins, and barrels. All wood. So we cut the trees. Simple.
Every time we cut a tree, an elf diplomat shows up and frowns.
So we get the wood AND a frown. Two for one!
The frown comes with an ambush.
Ambushes are just surprise visits. We're a welcoming fort.
Spring means fresh crops, fresh migrants, fresh hope.
Spring means the river thaws and the carp wake up hungry.
Not everything is about carp!
Everything is a little bit about carp.
The masterwork chair in the dining hall should go to whoever works hardest.
So, not you.
Nor YOU.
Then the cat gets the chair. Is that what you want?
The cat already HAS the chair.
Then the matter has been settled democratically.
No sieges, no beasts, no ambushes. Everyone's relaxed. I hate it.
Peace is good! Dwarves are happy! The ale flows!
That's EXACTLY what they want us to think.
Who's 'they'?
I don't know yet. That's how good they are.

debate.topic: IS SUMMER TOO HOT FOR BEARDS?
lines: It's summer. Beards should be trimmed for the season. For hygiene.
Trimmed? You'd shear a dwarf like a sheep? In {year}?
A shorter beard keeps the soup out!
The soup is the beard's business. Stay out of the beard's business.

world.text: From the mountainhome tonight: the monarch of {civ} has issued a statement on the price of ale. The statement is 'no'.
Elven diplomats have declared a new forest sacred. Sources say it is all of them.
Goblin activity is up across the region. Experts say it is either a siege forming or a very large picnic.
Travelling bards report a new song sweeping the human towns. It is about a sad tree. Again.
Kobold raiders have stolen a sock from a hillside village. Authorities are 'not ruling out' a second sock.
The {civ} treasury reports record earnings, largely from forts like {fort} sending things home. You're welcome, mountainhome.
Human merchants claim the roads are safer than ever. They said this from behind several guards.
Rumours from the far hills speak of a dragon. Confirmed reports speak of an unconfirmed dragon.
A mountainhome noble has demanded a new throne room. The old one has reportedly been 'looked at too much'.
Elves have once again objected to the concept of axes. Lumber prices across {world} remain steady.
Across {world} tonight: goblins deny any plans to invade. They also deny having a dark fortress.
A travelling bard reports that a human hero has slain a giant. The giant reportedly disputes this.
Scholars at the mountainhome have completed a ten-year study concluding that ale is good. Funding renewed.
Human kingdoms report an outbreak of feathered hats. DNN's fashion desk advises caution.
A necromancer's tower has been spotted in the distant wastes. Local estate agents say it has 'character'.
The {civ} army held its annual parade at the mountainhome. Only three soldiers tripped on their beards.
Rumours persist of a lost fortress full of gold. Other rumours persist that it is full of whatever ate the gold.
Elven caravans are said to be on the move. Somewhere, a tree is relaxing.
Goblin ambassadors reportedly visited a human town and left with the town. Developing story.
Kobolds have been sighted near a cave mouth. Officials urge citizens to count their spoons.
From the mountainhome: the monarch's favourite cat has been made an honorary noble. It has already issued a mandate.
A human lord has declared war on a neighbouring human lord over a goat. The goat could not be reached for comment.
Bards across {world} report that a forgotten beast has been remembered. Witnesses wish they hadn't.
{civ} leadership has thanked {fort} for its contributions. The letter arrived three seasons late and slightly damp.
Elves insist their wooden armour is 'grown, not made'. Dwarven smiths have been laughing for a week.
Goblin recruiters are reportedly offering trolls 'competitive benefits'. The main benefit is being hit less.
A mountainhome census reports the population of {civ} is up. Mostly cats.
Human scholars now claim the world is round. Dwarven scholars note it is clearly made of rock, which is the important part.
A wandering poet was caught reciting near the mountainhome gates. Guards escorted him to the tavern, where that is allowed.
A distant fortress reports it has struck adamantine. A later report from the same fortress has not arrived.
Elves have sent a strongly worded letter to every dwarven civilisation. It was written on bark. The irony has been noted.
The {civ} trade council warns of a looming rope reed shortage. Nobody knows what we use it for, but we want it.
Travelling bards say a human hero retired after his fiftieth beast. He now runs a small inn and won't talk about it.
From the mountainhome: the royal brewer has been promoted to senior royal brewer. Celebrations lasted six days.
Kobold scholars have reportedly invented writing. Their first word, roughly translated, is 'mine'.
A vampire has been unmasked in a human city. He was the mayor. Residents say they are 'not surprised'.
Weather across {world} is described by our sources as 'outside'. DNN recommends staying in.
Elves and humans have signed a peace treaty. Analysts give it until the next time somebody cuts down a tree.
The goblin dark tower has announced a new spire. Critics call it 'pointy, menacing and frankly derivative'.
Rumours from the mountainhome suggest the monarch has been asking about {fort}. Specifically, about our ale.
A caravan from {civ} has been delayed by bandits, weather and, according to the driver, 'a feeling'.
Human towns report werebeast trouble at the full moon. DNN reminds viewers that nobody looks their best at the full moon.
Unverified reports say a titan has been seen striding over the mountains. The mountains are said to be 'concerned'.
The {civ} calendar committee confirms it is still {year}. More on that as it develops.
Elven hunters report a dwarf in their forest. The dwarf was reportedly 'just passing through, with an axe'.
In the mountainhome's long-running beard dispute, a judge has ruled beards may touch the floor but not the soup.
Bards report the goblins are holding talent shows in their pits. The winner was a troll. So was the loser.
Humans have reportedly started digging fortresses of their own. Results so far: one cellar, very proud.
A {season} festival is underway at the mountainhome. Attendance is mandatory. Enthusiasm is optional.
Elves are furious that the latest dwarven treaty was engraved in stone. 'It will last forever,' they complained.
And finally, a goblin has been praised across {world} for an act of kindness. Further investigation revealed he was lost.
{citizen} passes on a rumour from a merchant: somewhere out there is a fort with too much ale. DNN is investigating.
